subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: Difficulty swallowing, especially with bigger pieces of food, and chest pain.
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 45 years old, and I'm male. I've been having trouble swallowing, especially with bigger pieces of food, and it hurts when I swallow down in my chest. It's been going on for a few weeks. Doctor: Have you experienced any weight loss, regurgitation, or chest pain associated with your dysphagia? Have you been evaluated for GERD or other esophageal disorders in the past? Patient: No, I haven't lost any weight—I actually gained some, which is frustrating. I haven't had any regurgitation, but the chest pain when I swallow is pretty consistent. I don't think I've ever been checked for GERD or anything like that before. Doctor: Could you describe the nature of the chest pain you experience when swallowing? For example, is it sharp, burning, or pressure-like? Does it radiate to other areas, such as your back or arms? Also, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or difficulty with eating over the past few weeks? Patient: The pain feels like a burning sensation in my chest, especially when I swallow bigger pieces of food. It doesn't really radiate anywhere else, just stays in that area. I haven't really noticed a change in my appetite, but I do find it harder to eat certain things because of the discomfort. Doctor: Have you undergone any imaging or endoscopic evaluations of the esophagus or upper gastrointestinal tract? Patient: No, I haven't had any imaging or endoscopic evaluations of my esophagus or upper gastrointestinal tract yet. The doctor mentioned something about a barium swallow, but I wasn't sure what that was exactly. I just came in because I've been having trouble swallowing and the pain has been getting me worried. Doctor: Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing liquids or only solids? Have you noticed any changes in your voice or coughing while eating? Patient: I haven't had any trouble swallowing liquids, just the bigger pieces of food. I
